title: Regulation F for AI Voice Debt Collection: The 7-in-7 Ledger, the Limited-Content Message, and the Per-Debt Architecture
summary: The CFPB's Regulation F call-frequency presumption, post-conversation wait, limited-content message, and channel opt-out rules are mechanical and per-debt. The agent design we run so an AI voice program does not inherit a 1006.14 harassment finding from a dialer it replaced.
